evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates creating a new game with name/description.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates the specific invitation-via-URL requirement.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: This specific start-a-round input method is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Moderator view of all session items is distinct from other stories.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting an item for estimation is a distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Manual adding of items during play differs from import/copy features.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing items is a separate capability from creating or importing them.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deletion of items is distinct and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Moderator ability to show estimates immediately (even if not all given) is unique.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting the average as the agreed estimate is a distinct business rule.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-fill on unanimous card is a specific behavior not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of agreed estimate is different from other automated acceptance rules.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating previously estimated stories is a distinct requirement.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Import from spreadsheet is a distinct import mechanism (not duplicated).

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste is a different method from import and is not redundant with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing game list is different from viewing/exporting transcripts and is unique.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript is distinct from browsing games or exporting in formats.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export as HTML is a specific format requirement and not duplicate of other stories.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export as CSV is a distinct format/business rule from HTML export.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting games is not duplicated by other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation with specified fields is unique.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login requirement is distinct from account creation and other account actions.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Editing account details is a distinct capability.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is distinct from deleting games and other account actions.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display preference is unique and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder by email is a distinct account-recovery feature.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Selecting card scale (modified Fibonacci vs powers of two) is a specific option not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Limit on number of invitees is a distinct constraint, not duplicated by invitation mechanism story.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Estimator joining by entering name is distinct from moderator invitation actions.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Estimator viewing the current item is unique compared to moderator inputs.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Estimator's view of planned items is distinct from moderator's similar story due to actor difference.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Immediate indicator that a particular estimator has given an estimate is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Participant requirement for simultaneous reveal after all have played is distinct.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-041 which expresses the same condition for changing an estimate (draw not completed).

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates per estimator is distinct and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Seeing mapping of who gave which estimates differs from merely seeing who has acted.

evaluations.evidence: be able start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Manual start of a visible timer is unique functionality.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Auto-reset behavior of the timer is a distinct requirement from manual start.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Participant ability to review prior rounds is distinct and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering consistency is a specific UI requirement, not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-034 which expresses the same permission to change estimates until the draw completes.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Adding a thumbnail photo is a distinct personalization feature.

evaluations.evidence: have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Developer standard-compliance requirement is unique.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Maintaining a glossary is a distinct documentation requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Database indexing for performance is a distinct developer task, not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Support for specific legacy browsers is a distinct compatibility requirement.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is a unique non-functional requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance/responsiveness requirement is distinct and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Support for Unicode input/display is a unique requirement.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: Readable predictable URLs is a distinct usability requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Custom error pages are a unique UX requirement.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Anonymized storage for research is a specific privacy requirement not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Request for usage metrics (as a specific persona 'Mike') is distinct.
